name: OTHERLIVED: The Experience Day Club
description: OTHERLIVED offers clients a full twelve-hour recorded-day experience in the neural perspective of a consenting subject: the catalog ranges from a Spire logistics executive's 2214 Tuesday to a Shelf courier's 2211 overnight run to a now-deceased pre-Collapse urban farmer's final harvest season. The BCI overlay is complete — sensory, emotional, proprioceptive — with the subject's actual thoughts replaced by a navigable ambient impression rather than verbatim inner monologue, preserving some privacy while maintaining emotional authenticity. The club's most controversial category is its Extinct Lives archive: experiences drawn from people who have since died.
story_hooks: A client living an archived Shelf courier day realizes mid-session that the courier recorded something they weren't supposed to see — and that someone is monitoring which clients choose this particular experience
A Tier 1 resident discovers their own daily life has been recorded and is being sold as an OTHERLIVED experience without their consent or compensation
A Spire executive uses OTHERLIVED's cross-tier catalog to understand how a specific whistleblower thinks — and then uses that knowledge to hunt them
